Today's update includes news on the next era of Marvel Digital Comics Webtoons and a November cyclone impacting the Chennai–Puducherry coast.

## The next era of Marvel Digital Comics Webtoons
The next era of Marvel Digital Comics Webtoons is set to launch with a new Marvel Comics app on November 16, 2026. Developed in partnership with WEBTOON, this new application will become the primary digital home for Marvel's extensive comic library, eventually replacing the Marvel Unlimited service, which is scheduled to shut down on December 7, 2026. The app will provide access to over 35,000 digital comics, supporting both traditional page-based and vertical-scroll formats, catering to the growing interest in webtoons. Subscribers will have options for different tiers, allowing access to new issues as early as 30 days after their print release. Existing Marvel Unlimited members will be able to migrate their libraries and reading histories to the new platform. This launch signifies a major shift in how fans will access and experience Marvel's digital comics.

## November cyclone for the Chennai–Puducherry coast
A severe cyclonic storm named Murasu is currently impacting India's southern states, with landfall anticipated on the Andhra Pradesh coast after midnight tonight, November 3rd. The cyclone is expected to bring heavy rainfall across Tamil Nadu and Andhra Pradesh. In response to the impending weather, schools in Chennai and Andhra Pradesh have announced closures for Tuesday, November 3rd. This marks the second significant cyclonic event in the Bay of Bengal within days, following the earlier Cyclone Arnab. Authorities are advising residents in affected areas to brace for adverse weather conditions.
